plan_of_care.description: The written care plan and patient-specific goals described in the account.
plan_of_care.explanation: The policy requires an individual written care plan with patient-specific services and measurable goals, connecting this node to how care is planned.

individualized_goals.description: The written care plan and patient-specific goals described in the account.
individualized_goals.explanation: The policy requires an individual written care plan with patient-specific services and measurable goals, connecting this node to how care is planned.

missed_visit.description: Planned or delivered visits, including wording about missed services. Refusals, exceptions and documentation require context.
missed_visit.note: Planned services, refusals, rescheduling and documentation gaps must be distinguished; a missed-visit phrase alone does not establish noncompliance.
missed_visit.explanation: The policy requires patients to receive the services in their care plan, connecting this node to planned visits, delivered care and explanations for missed services.

home_visits.description: Planned or delivered visits, including wording about missed services. Refusals, exceptions and documentation require context.
home_visits.explanation: The policy requires patients to receive the services in their care plan, connecting this node to planned visits, delivered care and explanations for missed services.

visit_schedule.description: The planned frequency, duration or written schedule of visits.
visit_schedule.explanation: The policy requires the care plan to state visit frequency and duration and patients to receive a written schedule, connecting this node to how visits are arranged.

skilled_nursing.description: Professional care described in the account, including assessment, ordered services and coordination.
skilled_nursing.explanation: The policy requires qualified professionals to provide ordered care and coordinate services, connecting this node to the professional care described in the record.

physical_therapy.description: Professional care described in the account, including assessment, ordered services and coordination.
physical_therapy.explanation: The policy requires qualified professionals to provide ordered care and coordinate services, connecting this node to the professional care described in the record.

occupational_therapy.description: Professional care described in the account, including assessment, ordered services and coordination.
occupational_therapy.explanation: The policy requires qualified professionals to provide ordered care and coordinate services, connecting this node to the professional care described in the record.

home_health_aide.description: Home health aide duties, assigned care and reporting described in the account.
home_health_aide.explanation: The policy sets out aide duties, instructions and reporting responsibilities, connecting this node to how personal care is provided.

comprehensive_assessment.description: Assessment of the patient’s condition, needs, medications and available support.
comprehensive_assessment.explanation: The policy requires a patient-specific assessment of health, care needs, medications and support, connecting this node to the information used to plan care.

resumption_of_care.description: Assessment updates when care resumes after a qualifying hospital admission.
resumption_of_care.explanation: The policy requires an assessment update after a qualifying hospital stay, connecting this node to how care is reviewed when the patient returns home.

physician_notification.description: Communication with the treating physician or allowed practitioner, including changes in condition or care needs.
physician_notification.explanation: The policy requires the agency to alert the treating practitioner to relevant changes and coordinate care, connecting this node to how clinical information is shared.

clinical_record.description: The clinical record and notes describing care, interventions, responses and authenticated entries.
clinical_record.explanation: The policy requires accurate clinical records of assessments, care, responses and signed entries, connecting this node to how services are documented.

clinical_notes.description: The clinical record and notes describing care, interventions, responses and authenticated entries.
clinical_notes.explanation: The policy requires accurate clinical records of assessments, care, responses and signed entries, connecting this node to how services are documented.

medication_review.description: Medication information and review of the drugs a patient uses.
medication_review.explanation: The policy requires review of all medications for problems such as side effects, interactions and duplicate therapy, connecting this node to medication information used in care.

medication_profile.description: Medication information and review of the drugs a patient uses.
medication_profile.explanation: The policy requires review of all medications for problems such as side effects, interactions and duplicate therapy, connecting this node to medication information used in care.

wound_care.description: Assessment, orders, treatment or documentation concerning a wound.
wound_care.explanation: The policy requires ordered treatments in the care plan to be delivered by appropriate professionals, connecting this node to how wound care is planned and provided.

clinical_manager.description: The clinical manager’s oversight role and contact information.
clinical_manager.explanation: The policy requires a clinical manager to oversee patient care and requires patients to receive the manager’s contact information, connecting this node to clinical oversight and access.

patient_rights.description: Patient rights, notices, participation and protections described in the account.
patient_rights.explanation: The policy requires the agency to explain and protect patient rights, connecting this node to participation, privacy, choices and protections during care.

legal_representative.description: The role of a patient representative in exercising rights. Capacity and authority require case-specific context.
legal_representative.explanation: The policy explains how patients and their legal representatives exercise rights, connecting this node to who can participate in care decisions.

staffing.description: Availability and assignment of personnel needed to deliver and oversee care.
staffing.explanation: The policy requires qualified personnel and clinical oversight during operating hours, connecting this node to staff availability and care assignments.

infection_control.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
infection_control.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and an agency program to identify and control infections, connecting this node to precautions and practices during care.

hand_hygiene.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
hand_hygiene.note: Standard precautions are the general regulatory anchor; the applicable clinical guidance and observed activity determine the specific practice.
hand_hygiene.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and an agency program to identify and control infections, connecting this node to precautions and practices during care.

ppe.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
ppe.note: PPE selection depends on the activity and exposure. This general provision does not prescribe the same equipment for every visit.
ppe.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and an agency program to identify and control infections, connecting this node to precautions and practices during care.

gloves.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
gloves.note: Glove use depends on the activity and exposure; a glove mention is not evidence of infection.
gloves.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and an agency program to identify and control infections, connecting this node to precautions and practices during care.

eye_protection.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
eye_protection.note: Task-specific and pandemic-era guidance must be checked against the survey date; this is a general infection-prevention anchor.
eye_protection.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and an agency program to identify and control infections, connecting this node to precautions and practices during care.

covid_19.description: Infection-prevention wording about programs, precautions, practices or clinical background. A mention does not establish transmission.
covid_19.note: Current infection-prevention provisions provide general context; pandemic-era CMS/CDC guidance, expired rules, waivers and state requirements require survey-date review.
covid_19.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and control of communicable diseases. This node relates to COVID-19 precautions, with the specific practices depending on the guidance in place at the time.

supervisory_visit.description: Visits or observations used to supervise home health aide services.
supervisory_visit.explanation: The policy requires oversight and assessment of home health aide services, connecting this node to supervisory visits and checks of aide care.

start_of_care.description: The initial assessment and beginning-of-care process described in the account.
start_of_care.explanation: The policy sets requirements for initial and comprehensive assessments at the beginning of care, connecting this node to how services begin.

care_coordination.description: Sharing information and coordinating care across the people and disciplines involved.
care_coordination.explanation: The policy requires communication among practitioners and integration of services, connecting this node to how the care team shares information and works together.

case_conference.description: Sharing information and coordinating care across the people and disciplines involved.
case_conference.note: Coordination is the care obligation; a mention of a case conference does not establish a universal meeting-format requirement.
case_conference.explanation: The policy requires communication among practitioners and integration of services, connecting this node to how the care team shares information and works together.

physician_orders.description: Orders for services, medications or treatment, including how orders are recorded and followed.
physician_orders.explanation: The policy requires care orders to be recorded and services and treatments to follow authorized orders, connecting this node to how instructions guide care.

verbal_orders.description: Orders communicated verbally and their recording, signatures and authentication.
verbal_orders.explanation: The policy sets rules for who may receive verbal orders and how they are recorded, signed and confirmed, connecting this node to the handling of spoken instructions.

patient_education.description: Patient or caregiver involvement, teaching and preparation for the care identified in the plan.
patient_education.explanation: The policy requires patient and caregiver involvement and teaching about planned care, connecting this node to preparation for care at home.

caregiver.description: Patient or caregiver involvement, teaching and preparation for the care identified in the plan.
caregiver.explanation: The policy requires patient and caregiver involvement and teaching about planned care, connecting this node to preparation for care at home.

administration_record.description: Documentation of medication administration and the patient’s response.
administration_record.note: The provision addresses recording interventions and responses, not a universal requirement for one named MAR form.
administration_record.explanation: The policy requires medications to be given as ordered and interventions and responses to be recorded, connecting this node to documentation of medication administration.

pressure_injury.description: Skin or pressure-injury wording concerning assessment, risks, treatment or documentation.
pressure_injury.explanation: The policy requires assessment of the patient’s condition and care planning for treatments and safety, connecting this node to skin concerns and their management.

skin_condition.description: Skin or pressure-injury wording concerning assessment, risks, treatment or documentation.
skin_condition.explanation: The policy requires assessment of the patient’s condition and care planning for treatments and safety, connecting this node to skin concerns and their management.

infection_surveillance.description: Agency tracking, identification, investigation or follow-up of infectious disease concerns.
infection_surveillance.explanation: The policy requires a system to identify, track and investigate infectious disease concerns, connecting this node to the agency’s infection monitoring.

qapi.description: The agency’s quality assessment and performance improvement program.
qapi.explanation: The policy requires an agency-wide program to measure care quality and address problems, connecting this node to how the agency improves services.

improvement_project.description: A performance improvement project, its scope, implementation or evaluation.
improvement_project.note: The project requirement began July 13, 2018; do not apply it automatically to earlier survey dates.
improvement_project.explanation: The policy requires performance improvement projects beginning July 13, 2018, connecting this node to planned efforts to address identified care problems.

falls.description: Falls or fall-risk wording in the source. Risk statements and precautions are different from actual injury.
falls.explanation: The policy requires assessment and safety measures in the care plan, connecting this node to how fall risks and related care needs are addressed.

competency.description: Staff ability or qualifications to perform assigned work; aide and professional requirements have different scopes.
competency.note: Aide competency evaluation under 484.80(c) must be distinguished from professional qualifications and supervision.
competency.explanation: The policy sets professional qualification requirements and specific competency checks for aides, connecting this node to whether workers are prepared for their assigned tasks.

orientation.description: Staff orientation, training or in-service education described in the account.
orientation.note: Aide training and in-service requirements are role-specific; broader staff orientation wording requires review of applicable professional and agency requirements.
orientation.explanation: The policy requires qualified staff and sets training and in-service requirements for aides, connecting this node to how personnel are prepared to provide care.

personnel_files.description: Personnel documentation relevant to qualifications or staff policies.
personnel_files.note: These are qualification and personnel-policy anchors, not a requirement that every item use a particular file format.
personnel_files.explanation: The policy requires the agency to employ qualified personnel and maintain personnel policies. This node relates to the records used to show that staff meet those requirements.

discharge_summary.description: Information prepared or sent to support the transition after discharge.
discharge_summary.explanation: The policy requires a discharge summary and care information for the next practitioner, connecting this node to the handoff when agency services end.

transfer_summary.description: Information prepared or sent when care transfers to another facility.
transfer_summary.explanation: The policy requires a transfer summary and relevant care information for the receiving facility, connecting this node to continuity when care moves elsewhere.

discharge_assessment.description: The comprehensive-assessment update at discharge, including relevant OASIS wording.
discharge_assessment.explanation: The policy requires an assessment update at discharge, connecting this node to the record of the patient’s condition when agency care ends.

referrals.description: Referrals or coordination of services and providers described in the account.
referrals.explanation: The policy assigns responsibility for coordinating referrals and care, connecting this node to how patients are connected with needed services.

patient_refusal.description: A patient declining care or services. Exercising a right to refuse is not itself a care failure.
patient_refusal.explanation: The policy gives patients the right to participate in and refuse care and addresses discharge when services are refused, connecting this node to how those decisions are handled.

clinical_supervision.description: Oversight of professional services and assistants, distinct from aide supervisory visits.
clinical_supervision.explanation: The policy requires appropriate supervision of professional assistants and oversight of patient services, connecting this node to who directs and checks care.

fit_test.description: Fit testing for a tight-fitting respirator described in the account.
fit_test.note: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134(f) applies to required tight-fitting respirator use within its scope; it is not a CMS requirement to fit-test every worker for every visit. Check occupational jurisdiction and historical guidance.
fit_test.explanation: OSHA requires fit testing when workers must use tight-fitting respirators, while CMS requires infection-prevention practices. This node relates to checks that the required respirator fits the worker.

service_gap.description: Unexplained missed visits can be mentioned in requirements, patient refusal or documentation gaps; not proof of injury.
service_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
service_gap.explanation: The policy requires patients to receive ordered services in their care plan, connecting this node to concerns about visits or treatments that were not provided.

assessment_gap.description: Missing documentation, late completion/signature and absent assessment are different; this screen does not adjudicate timing exceptions.
assessment_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
assessment_gap.explanation: The policy requires a complete assessment and updates as needs change, connecting this node to concerns about missing, incomplete or delayed assessment.

order_gap.description: Order/documentation mismatch is not necessarily absent or harmful treatment; healed wounds and revised orders require context.
order_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
order_gap.explanation: The policy requires an individual care plan and recorded orders that guide treatment, connecting this node to concerns about missing instructions or care that differs from the plan.

medication_gap.description: Narrow review/administration deficit wording; not all medication errors, and medication names or MAR absence alone are insufficient.
medication_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
medication_gap.explanation: The policy requires medication review and administration according to authorized orders, connecting this node to concerns about how medications are checked or given.

escalation_gap.description: Reported absence and absent documentation can both appear; not a complete legal notification finding.
escalation_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
escalation_gap.explanation: The policy requires timely alerts about relevant changes and coordination among practitioners, connecting this node to concerns about clinical communication and response.

infection_gap.description: Exposure/prevention wording is not patient infection. Pandemic/state rules need dated applicability review.
infection_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
infection_gap.explanation: The policy requires infection-prevention practices and a system for identifying and controlling infection risks, connecting this node to concerns about precautions during care.

competency_gap.description: A missing form or location field does not establish absent training or unsafe skill; professional supervision can be distinct from aide supervision.
competency_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
competency_gap.explanation: The policy requires qualified workers, aide competency checks and appropriate supervision, connecting this node to concerns about staff preparation or oversight.

handoff_gap.description: Missing handoff information is not proof of interrupted coverage or hospitalization caused by the agency.
handoff_gap.note: Conceptual care-obligation anchor for a provisional research screen. Policy does not prescribe the text patterns, equal weights or capped family-breadth score; this is not a validated clinical severity grade.
handoff_gap.explanation: The policy requires discharge or transfer summaries and care information for the next provider, connecting this node to concerns about information missing from a handoff.
